notes.title: Update 6.5 - More Adventure Mode
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39261595/e020e8a38a02a781b69b432e5d8c96f5e4477296.png[/img]
[h1]Leaderboard[/h1]
A leaderboard is now available for the new Adventure game mode. It shows all time records as well as records set only in the last 7 days.

Also, some Adventure mode related bugs were fixed.

[h3]All changes:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Adventure mode leaderboard is now available
[*]half tiles from boxes modifier now works correctly
[*]missing modifier description added
[*]fixed a bug that made activating Zen Mode in other game modes possible
[*]Zen Mode doesn't have a lighthouse button anymore
[*]fixed a case where you could end an Adventure level without marking it as completed
[*]saving an adventure level and continuing it twice doesn't break the game now
[*]modifiers in Adventure mode now save and load correctly
[/list]

notes.title: Update 6 - Adventure game mode
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39261595/e837e7930d22aec33a900143b4ebf0ba07c5a529.png[/img]
[h1]Adventure game mode[/h1]
A new game mode is introduced to Zen World!

In Adventure mode, you complete series of levels with various modifiers, picking you path through them, and keeping your tiles and other placeables between levels. If you fail to achieve the level goal or run out of tiles, you'll have to start from the beginning in a completely new random world.

[h1]Adventure leaderboard[/h1]
At this point, adventure mode still needs some work. We're planning to introduce a leaderboard and more improvements in a patch next week. Meanwhile, you can see your best result and the world record, but rest assured that all scores are saved and could be used in the future.

[h1]New Daily format[/h1]
Also, starting today, Daily Challenge is limited to only 2 attempts per day. It is an experimental new format that we'll run this season and see if we'll keep it or change in the future. The new season will last for 4 weeks.

notes.title: Update 5 - Optimization and bugfixes
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39261595/a033f9117a49a3064a1e265bbd306c1e57032a12.png[/img]
[h1]Optimization and bugfixes[/h1]
This is a preparational update before a large patch that will introduce a new game mode for the Zen World.

For a long time now a few relatively common bugs have been plaguing the game making matches, it in some cases, unfinishable. In this update we've hopefully fixed most of those game-breaking bugs.

Also, game works faster now due to some optimization, most notably in the menu, but it should affect all gameplay on slower machines.

[h1]Patchnotes:[/h1]
[list]
[*]a couple of linked memory leaks that made the game unplayable sometimes have been fixed
[*]people walking across the water should be correctly displayed as boats now
[*]the world overview is correctly scaled after continuing a previous game
[*]back button in the menu is positioned correctly now
[*]a slightly better system to detect cheating is implemented
[*]a few optimizations should make the game faster on slow machines
[*]menu animations should not lag so much in slow machines
[*]Space button now moves the camera to the last built town
[*]numbers on the buttons in the inventory are more visible now
[/list]

[h1]New game mode teaser and future of Daily Challenge[/h1]
Here is a small teaser image for the upcoming big new game mode for you!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39261595/ac1146efaf6c5b8afad50389f7aba9d894ede193.png[/img]
We won't tell more for now, but you can probably guess quite a lot from that image alone!

Another issue that was discussed a lot recently is limiting daily challenge to one try per day. We are willing to experiment with that in the same update that introduces the new game mode, so that you can play it instead of Daily Challenge if one try is not enough for you. That probably means that the new game mode will go live at the end of the current Daily season.

notes.title: Update 4 - New Daily Season and Modifiers
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39261595/5b2efbac20671344f0ae8cee04754d3fbe62546e.png[/img]
[h1]New Daily Season[/h1]
The Season 3 of the Daily Champions has just begun!

Congratulations to the top 3 players this time around:

[olist]
[*]Scattsound
[*]mbutton15
[*]dutpar
[/olist]

These players, as well as the top 10 of the current leaderboard got their trophies to be displayed forever, congratulations!

All Daily Challenge Champions points are reset, and it's now your chance to get to the top!

We were considering limiting daily challenge to one try a day in the next season but decided against it for the time being. There will be a post in discussions later explaining in more detail why, but basically, most players rarely played more than one or two tries every day anyway. 

[h1]New and reworked modifiers[/h1]
Five new Daily Modifiers will be added this season, let us know what you think about them!

Also, some of the old modifiers were reworked, notably, there are now some modifiers that give extra items in the beginning of the match, and some reducing the starting tiles amount.

[h1]Following updates[/h1]
The updates were not as frequent as we'd like them to be lately. We hope to improve this in the future, as there's been some reshuffling of the development plan and a new Adventure mode will probably be introduced in one of the next updates.

notes.title: Update 3 - Monuments and Wonders
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39261595/b0882126be1973e028b94e45cede688c11286d46.png[/img]
[h1]Monuments[/h1]
The Monuments are a special type of placeable structure that gives you score points for the surrounding tiles depending on the type of the Monument.

Right now, there are 3: Windmill, Lighthouse, and Hunting Tower. They give you points for every plain, sea or forest around them respectively. Note that the Lighthouse gives only half as many points because it's really easy to generate a lot of water in one place.

You get them from a special type of box - a Green Box. Every second box you get from score starting from 50 points is a Green Box.

[h1]Wonders[/h1]
There is currently only one Wonder and it is a Mega Mountain! There is usually one in the Sandbox mode and it might appear in Daily challenges sometimes. You get score points just for discovering it, but also for placing tiles around it. Beware, though, it might give you a lot of points but at what cost?

[h1]Lookout tower rework[/h1]
Lookout towers are now a thing of the past. The most useless power-up was removed and instead all new monuments act as a Lookout Tower in addition to their score-granting abilities.

[h1]Land Reclamation[/h1]
A new type of power-up was introduced to replace Lookout Towers. It lets you fill all the water on a selected tile with random land. You can now fill the sea or cross rivers without using bridges!

[h1]Full patch notes:[/h1]
[h3]New features:[/h3]
[list]
[*] introduced Monuments and Wonders
[*] Land Reclamation to remove unwanted water (replaces Lookout Towers)
[*] every second score box is a Green Box containing random Monuments
[/list]
[h3]Balance:[/h3]
[list]
[*] much less score is now needed to get score boxes in the late game, but every second box only gives you Monuments
[*] reduced amount of water on water tiles
[*] reduced amount of water tiles given with More Water Tiles daily modifier
[*] 20% more towns spawn in Daily with modifier that pre-spawns town flags on tiles you place
[*] you can only place Exploration Marker over an existing tile now
[/list]
[h3]Bug fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] fixed a few typos
[/list]

notes.title: Update 2 - Save/Load
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39261595/eddf322491a95a4f007e554f8762cf4258772a56.png[/img]

You can now quit the game during the match and save your progress! More testing is still needed, that's why this feature is only enabled for the Sandbox for now, but it looks good so far.

If nothing game-breaking will come up, resuming the game will be also activated for the campaign soon.

notes.title: Save/Load update delay
notes.notes:
It's November 4 and the save/load update was scheduled to release today but we want to be upfront with you: it is not ready yet. Instead of forcing the release with possible bugs, we want to take time to improve and test it more.

The new planned date for the update is November 11 and in a few days, a beta branch will become available for people to test the new build in advance.

We are sorry for the delay, see you next week!

notes.title: Update 1 - Daily Champions
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39261595/86e5c9b1dc66b2d1d1db7481b6f0919bc5e354f7.png[/img]

Daily Champions is a way to preserve your progress in Daily Challenge.

Every day top 100 players from the Daily Challenge earn points depending on their leaderboard position:

1st place gets 15 points.
2nd place gets 13 points.
3rd place gets 11 points.
The rest of the top 10 get 8 points each.
11-30 places get 4 points each.
And finally, 31-100 get 1 point each.

These points go straight to your Daily Champions point pool, and there is now a new section of the Daily Leaderboard - Daily Champions Leaderboard! In that section, you can see the current leaderboard for the Champions points. The current top 3 players there get a fancy medal next to their name, and whoever is on the top will get a permanent trophy next to their name in all leaderboards at the end of the season (duration of the season is TBA)!

All Champion points for completing the Daily Challenge since the release of Zen World were already awarded, and all future points will be awarded on the next day after the game to correctly reflect today's record.

Values of points earned are subject to change and may be altered retrospectively in the future based on the Daily Challenge placement on the respective dates.

notes.title: Demo Update
notes.notes:
Hi!

Development of Zen World is going great, and today we are updating the demo to reflect the current state of the game, which is long overdue.

A lot has changed, most features mentioned in the old roadmap are implemented and if you've played the demo before, maybe give it another try to see if you like the direction the game is taking? Hopefully, it became less stressful, while keeping its strategic depth!

We also would be grateful if you can send us a filled feedback form (link is in the main menu of the game). That would help the development of the game a lot. Thank you!
